Trying to make sense of movement, exercise, rehab, and training - with an urge to give my uneducated opinion on philosophy and psychology.
When I started school, I wanted to become a writer or a scientist.
What held me back was believing I needed to be good at it.


I hold a PhD in Sport and Human Movement Science from the University of Vienna and a Bachelor’s degree in Physiotherapy.

**Embodymate** was originally created in 2015 as a loose collaboration between a Psychotherapist (Chris) and a sport scientist (Peter). Our professional paths diverged a bit, but I keep Embodymate mostly for nostalgic reasons. The name still has meaning to me!

In case you are missing any older content or are interested in psychotherapy, please contact my beloved colleague [Christoph Humnig](https://verhaltenstherapie-ybbsstrasse.jimdosite.com/) directly.
